description: You're a birder who needs to compile rough field notes into a structured citizen science observation log. A text file with your field notes is at /home/ga/Documents/field_notes_march2024.txt. Create a new spreadsheet in OnlyOffice Calc that organizes these observations with proper columns (Date, Time, Location, Species, Count, Notes/Confidence). Handle uncertain identifications and missing data appropriately. Save as XLSX in /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/ with a meaningful filename like 'Birding_Log_March2024.xlsx'.
